title: The Charter Is Raised
body: In Spring of Year {year}, the council raised its first banners at {site}. Eight known places formed the first map of the realm.

title: {site} Enters the Map
body: Scouts returned from {site} in {season} of Year {year}, adding {region} to the council's living map.

title: A New Year Opens
body: Year {year} began with the council still measuring promise against distance.

title: {site} Is Founded
body: In {season} of Year {year}, settlers raised a charter camp at {site}, carrying stores and hard promises into {region}.

title: {site} Grows
body: {site} crossed a new threshold in {season} of Year {year}, proving that a frontier holding could become something sturdier.

title: Hunger Reaches {site}
body: Food stores failed at {site} in {season} of Year {year}. Stability and loyalty began to bend under empty granaries.

title: {site} Is Abandoned
body: Neglect and hunger broke {site} in {season} of Year {year}. The chronicle marked the place as a warning to the realm.

title: A First Path Is Funded
body: In {season} of Year {year}, the council funded a new path near {site}, turning a map line into a working promise.

title: A Road Is Strengthened
body: Workers improved the route near {site} in {season} of Year {year}, giving the capital network a sturdier reach.

title: A Bridge Washes Out
body: Spring water damaged the route near {site} in Year {year}, slowing supply until repairs could be organized.

title: A Caravan Is Attacked
body: Trouble found the road near {site} in {season} of Year {year}; traders began asking whether the council could protect its own routes.

title: Winter Blocks a Path
body: Snow and neglect blocked the path near {site} in Winter of Year {year}, cutting into the realm's supply confidence.

title: {site} Feels Isolated
body: {site} suffered from weak road supply in {season} of Year {year}. Loyalty and stability began to drift away from the capital.

title: Trail Wardens Take Post
body: The council completed a regional patrol project around {site} in {season} of Year {year}, reducing future road trouble and frontier danger.

title: The Council Falls Behind
body: By {season} of Year {year}, petitions and road duties outpaced the council's reach. Unmanaged strain became part of the realm's story.
